AUTO_WITHDRAW_ONLY: {walletType} wallets withdraw automatically on schedule — manual withdrawal is not available
CANNOT_TRANSFER_TO_SELF: Cannot transfer to your own wallet
RECIPIENT_NO_ELIGIBLE_WALLET: Recipient has no {currency} wallet eligible to receive this transfer
TRANSFER_NOT_ALLOWED: This transfer is not allowed between these two wallets
MERCHANT_NO_ELIGIBLE_WALLET: Merchant has no {currency} wallet eligible to receive purchases
PURCHASE_NOT_ALLOWED: This purchase is not allowed between these two wallets
INSTALLMENT_ALREADY_PAID: This installment has already been paid
NO_LINKED_REPOSITORY_TO_REPAY: This wallet has no linked repository to repay
REPOSITORY_NOT_DEPOSITABLE: This repository does not accept installment repayments
WALLET_NOT_BLOCKED: This wallet is not currently blocked for overdue installments
NO_OUTSTANDING_INSTALLMENTS: This wallet has no outstanding installments to collect
ONLY_CREDIT_OFFBOARDING: Only CREDIT wallets can be closed through offboarding
NO_LINKED_REPOSITORY: This wallet has no linked repository
WALLET_CANNOT_RECEIVE_FOR_MERCHANT: That wallet cannot receive purchases for this merchant
NO_ELIGIBLE_WALLET_FOR_CURRENCY: You have no {currency} wallet eligible to receive purchases
PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND_UNRESOLVED: Purchase not found, already resolved, or has no wallet attached yet
PENDING_PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND: No pending purchase found with that id — it may already be resolved
IP_NOT_ALLOWED: This request does not come from an allowed IP for this wallet
STORE_SITE_MISMATCH: This request does not originate from the wallet-registered store site
WALLET_BLOCKED: This wallet is blocked pending an overdue installment payment
TRANSACTION_NOT_YOURS: This transaction does not belong to you
